default"}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","h3","h3-2",{"children":"3) Watch outbound traffic like you mean it"}],"\n",["$","p","p-9",{"children":"Most exfil is boring: HTTPS to .\n"}]}],"\n",["$","h3","h3-6",{"children":"Runtime: log network destinations for a process '<process-name>'\n"}]}],"\n",["$","hr","hr-4",{}],"\n",["$","h2","h2-5",{"children":"What to look for in a real review"}],"\n",["$","p","p-11",{"children":"If you’re evaluating an “agent plugin” or
